Name: CP Rubber Duck Tile
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
[size=3]Inspired by the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35191]Bear Tile[/url] Mod you should totally go check them out!

There are 10 colors of rubber duck tile to choose from!

This mod adds new flooring options in it does not replace any of the existing options.

Works well with Happy Home Designer.[/size]

[b][i][u][size=4]Conflicts?[/size][/u][/i][/b]
[size=3]There are no current conflicts that I am aware of if you have any issues please comment and link your your smapi log. 

This does work in multiplayer as long as you all have the mod installed.[/size]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Rubber Duck Tile
Manifest.Description: Adds Rubber Duck Tile flooring to your home
Manifest.Author: QueenQuackin
